description: This Java class `SystemConfiguration` models a database entity for storing system configuration settings within the SalesManager e-commerce platform. It includes fields for configuration key-value pairs, audit information, and is annotated for persistence with JPA/Hibernate.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing system configuration settings, including audit fields, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with this configuration.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this configuration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this configuration entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this configuration entity.
